questions.question: He said, 'I will finish the report by tomorrow.' How would this be reported?
options: He said he would finish the report by tomorrow.
He said he will finish the report by tomorrow.
He said he had finished the report by tomorrow.
He said he finishes the report by tomorrow.
questions.answer: He said he would finish the report by tomorrow.
